title: Holiday - A Soldier Is Never Off Duty
desc: Virat, a soldier, uncovers a terrorist plot to bomb Mumbai. He assembles his team to stop the attack and protect the city from destruction.

title: Trimurti
desc: Falsely accused and jailed, Satyadevi hopes her three sons will free her and avenge her. But she discovers they live separate lives and despise one another.

title: Auron Mein Kahan Dum Tha
desc: Krishna and Vasudha's love story faces tragedy when Krishna is accused of murder. Released after 23 years in prison, he seeks closure and an emotional reunionwith Vasudha.

title: Pushpa 2: The Rule
desc: A powerful smuggler faces a vengeful enemy while juggling politics and crime. A public apology sparks a tense showdown that leads to a dramatic challenge.

title: Mom
desc: Devki, a biology teacher, turns to private detective DK after her stepdaughter's rapists are acquitted. Fueled by anguish, she vows revenge and sets out to deliver justice herself.

title: Pure Bollywood
desc: Bollywood songs - catchy, emotional, and upbeat - dominate the charts. From heartbreak to celebration, these tracks capture every mood, making people dance, cry, and sing along everywhere.

title: Dabangg 2
desc: Chulbul Pandey, a fearless cop, kills a corrupt politician's brother, sparking revenge. When his wife is attacked, an enraged Chulbul takes on his enemies to protect his family.

title: Seeta Aur Geeta
desc: Seeta runs away from her cruel aunt. Her look-alike Geeta takes over but gets arrested. Seeta is forced back into a life of suffering.

title: Bulandi
desc: Dharamraj Thakur, a respected village leader, faces disgrace when his younger brother Arjun is falsely accused of raping a schoolteacher, shaking the village's trust and honor.

title: Satyameva Jayate
desc: DCP Shivansh hunts the man killing corrupt cops, unaware the culprit is Vir-his own younger brother-setting them on a tragic collision course.

title: Raksha Bandhan
desc: The eldest brother of four sisters, a humble chaat seller, struggles to honor his ailing mother's wish while steadfastly protecting their family's values and dignity.

title: Hum Saath Saath Hain
desc: Ramkishan and Mamta live happily with their sons. But when tragedy strikes their daughter, Mamta's heart changes, and she turns against her kind stepson, Vivek.

title: Annapoorani : The Goddess Of Food
desc: Born into an orthodox Hindu family, Annapoorani dreams of becoming a top chef. Battling prejudice and rigid traditions, she must break barriers to pursue her passion and redefine her destiny.

title: Waqt-The Race Against Time
desc: Ishwar, facing terminal illness, decides to kick his son out to teach him responsibility. It's a tough love lesson that sparks growth and unexpected challenges.
